DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2606,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"U-Ming is directly exposed through Capesize, Panamax, Post-Panamax and Ultramax dry-bulk vessels. This is a direct current economic edge to the dry-bulk freight cycle.","Nominal fleet supply growth and macro/trade-policy weakness remain counter-risks, and U-Ming is diversifying into LNG and other shipping segments, reducing pure-play exposure.","https://www.uming.com.tw/news/News_detail.aspx?ID=PRE0153|https://www.uming.com.tw/news/News_detail.aspx?ID=PRE0152"

CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2615,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Wan Hai identifies itself as a marine container-shipping company whose business depends on container transport demand, route deployment and freight-rate conditions; its current tariff/bunker notices show direct commercial pricing exposure on major trades. CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2615,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Wan Hai identifies itself as a marine container-shipping company whose business depends on container transport demand, route deployment and freight-rate conditions; its current tariff/bunker notices show direct commercial pricing exposure on major trades. This is a direct operating edge to the container-freight cycle.","Fuel surcharges, vessel additions and route mix can change realized economics independently of headline spot freight indices; strong spot rates do not map one-for-one into earnings.","https://www.wanhai.com/FileView?file_name=204442.pdf&file_num=80640&file_path=www_files&in_line=in_line|https://www.wanhai.com/FileView?file_name=229996.pdf&file_num=64838&file_path=www_files"
CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2603,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Evergreen Marine is primarily a global container-shipping operator; its 2025 reporting shows freight revenue represented about 93% of operating revenue, while Taiwan's Maritime and Port Bureau lists Evergreen among national carriers filing route freight rates. This establishes direct economic sensitivity to the container-freight cycle.","Evergreen's scale, contract mix, bunker costs and fleet deployment can cause realized revenue and margins to diverge from spot indices; management has also flagged weaker demand/inflation risks beyond the peak season.","https://www.motcmpb.gov.tw/Information/Detail/c619bdab-9539-47ec-92e4-364608965d99?NodeId=10125&SiteId=1|https://quartr.com/events/evergreen-marine-corporation-taiwan-2603-q4-2025_FG31ggwf"
DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2605,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:25:00Z,2,"Sincere Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its principal business and its current fleet includes four Kamsarmax bulkers, seven Capesize bulkers and one 250,000-DWT ore carrier, establishing direct economic exposure to dry-bulk freight rates and tonne-mile demand.","The fleet also includes three VLCC crude tankers, so company earnings are not a pure dry-bulk proxy and can diverge from BDI/BCI when tanker economics move differently.","https://www.snc.com.tw/%E6%8A%95%E8%B3%87%E4%BA%BA%E9%97%9C%E4%BF%82/|https://www.snc.com.tw/%E6%96%B0%E8%88%88%E8%88%B9%E9%9A%8A/"
DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2617,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:25:00Z,2,"Taiwan Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its core business and reports 21 dry-bulk vessels in its fleet; July 2026 operating commentary also states that spot-linked vessel day rates rose with the dry-bulk market, directly demonstrating current transmission from freight conditions into operating economics.","Part of the fleet is protected by long-term contracts and the company also operates passenger/cargo ferry, harbor and special-vessel businesses, which dampens one-for-one sensitivity to spot dry-bulk indices.","https://www.taiwanline.com.tw/DATA/ESG/2024%E5%8F%B0%E8%88%AAESG%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E6%9B%B8.pdf|https://wealth.firstbank.com.tw/investment-tips/trend-insight/news/news-detail?id=%7B8C529218-57F1-45F9-B98F-DBAE6B056D48%7D"

AI_SERVER_SHIPMENTS,6669,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"Wiwynn is a hyperscale data-center and cloud-infrastructure ODM. This is direct current economic exposure to the AI-server shipment cycle.","Customer concentration and procurement-model changes can distort reported revenue versus physical shipment volume; strong AI demand therefore does not map one-for-one into revenue growth.","https://www.wiwynn.com/zh/news/wiwynn-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results?hs_amp=true|https://www.wiwynn.com/hubfs/Investors/Shareholders_Services/2026_Annual_Report_EN.pdf"
AI_SERVER_SHIPMENTS,3231,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"Wistron explicitly approved facility upgrades to support expansion of AI-related businesses and machinery/equipment spending to expand AI-server manufacturing capacity in Mexico; its 1H26 results also approved additional Taiwan capex primarily for machinery and equipment supporting future capacity expansion. This is direct manufacturing exposure to the AI-server shipment cycle.","Capacity expansion can precede realized shipments and margins; execution, customer mix and accelerator allocation remain material risks.","https://www.wistron.com/en/Newsroom/2026-03-12|https://www.wistron.com/en/Newsroom/2026-08-04"
POWER_ELECTRONICS_CAPEX,2308,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,3,"Delta explicitly positions itself from grid to chip for AI factories and data centers, with 800 VDC in-row power racks, UPS, DC/DC conversion, liquid cooling and microgrid products. These disclosures establish a direct current economic edge to power-electronics and data-center electrical capex.","Product exposure is broad and includes cooling/networking as well as power; deployment timing of next-generation 800 VDC architecture can shift, so not all announced products translate immediately into recognized revenue.","https://www.deltaww.com/en-US/investors/chairman-statement|https://www.deltaww.com/en-US/press/40273|https://www.deltaww.com/en-US/landing/Computex-2026"
POWER_ELECTRONICS_CAPEX,1519,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"Fortune Electric's investor materials identify transformers, switchboards and distribution equipment as its core revenue categories. This is a direct transformer/grid-equipment edge to the active power-capex cycle.","Transformer component shortages and long delivery lead times can delay revenue recognition even when demand and backlog are strong.","https://www.fortune.com.tw/tw/Investor_information.aspx|https://gfemobile.cnyes.com/news/id/6568409"
POWER_ELECTRONICS_CAPEX,1513,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"Chung-Hsin Electric's April 2026 investor briefing reported NT$43.1 billion of backlog and stated that Taiwan grid reinforcement, semiconductor expansion and international AI/IDC buildouts were driving GIS demand. This is direct grid-equipment exposure to the power-capex cycle.","The company has multiple business lines and overseas exposure remains limited; backlog conversion and project timing can make earnings sensitivity lag the capex cycle.","https://money.udn.com/money/amp/story/5612/9460327|https://nstock.tw/api/v2/stock-financial-report/report?type=0&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmopsov.twse.com.tw%2Fnas%2FSTR%2F151320260423M001.pdf"
DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2606,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"U-Ming is directly exposed through Capesize, Panamax, Post-Panamax and Ultramax dry-bulk vessels. DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2637,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,3,"Wisdom Marine identifies itself as a dry-bulk shipping company with a large diversified bulk fleet and predominantly charter-hire revenue. CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2609,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Yang Ming's August 2026 H1 results directly tie Q2 earnings improvement to Asia-Europe and Transpacific booking demand and higher freight-rate levels, and describe cargo demand, fleet deployment and capacity as key Q3 operating variables. This establishes direct current economic exposure to the container-freight cycle.","Yang Ming also cites global fleet-capacity growth exceeding container-demand growth and geopolitical/tariff uncertainty, so stronger spot rates may not persist uniformly across routes.","https://e-solution.yangming.com/News/press_release/PressContent.aspx?BulletinType=PressRelease&localSiteD=&uid=16068|https://esg.yangming.com/investors/information/investor-conference/"
CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2615,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Wan Hai identifies itself as a marine container-shipping company whose business depends on container transport demand, route deployment and freight-rate conditions; its current tariff/bunker notices show direct commercial pricing exposure on major trades. This is a direct operating edge to the container-freight cycle.","Fuel surcharges, vessel additions and route mix can change realized economics independently of headline spot freight indices; strong spot rates do not map one-for-one into earnings.","https://www.wanhai.com/FileView?file_name=204442.pdf&file_num=80640&file_path=www_files&in_line=in_line|https://www.wanhai.com/FileView?file_name=229996.pdf&file_num=64838&file_path=www_files"
CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2603,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Evergreen Marine is primarily a global container-shipping operator; its 2025 reporting shows freight revenue represented about 93% of operating revenue, while Taiwan's Maritime and Port Bureau lists Evergreen among national carriers filing route freight rates. DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2605,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:25:00Z,2,"Sincere Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its principal business and its current fleet includes four Kamsarmax bulkers, seven Capesize bulkers and one 250,000-DWT ore carrier, establishing direct economic exposure to dry-bulk freight rates and tonne-mile demand.","The fleet also includes three VLCC crude tankers, so company earnings are not a pure dry-bulk proxy and can diverge from BDI/BCI when tanker economics move differently.","https://www.snc.com.tw/%E6%8A%95%E8%B3%87%E4%BA%BA%E9%97%9C%E4%BF%82/|https://www.snc.com.tw/%E6%96%B0%E8%88%88%E8%88%B9%E9%9A%8A/"
DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2617,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:25:00Z,2,"Taiwan Navigation identifies dry-bulk shipping as its core business and reports 21 dry-bulk vessels in its fleet; July 2026 operating commentary also states that spot-linked vessel day rates rose with the dry-bulk market, directly demonstrating current transmission from freight conditions into operating economics.","Part of the fleet is protected by long-term contracts and the company also operates passenger/cargo ferry, harbor and special-vessel businesses, which dampens one-for-one sensitivity to spot dry-bulk indices.","https://www.taiwanline.com.tw/DATA/ESG/2024%E5%8F%B0%E8%88%AAESG%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E6%9B%B8.pdf|https://wealth.firstbank.com.tw/investment-tips/trend-insight/news/news-detail?id=%7B8C529218-57F1-45F9-B98F-DBAE6B056D48%7D"

DRY_BULK_FREIGHT,2606,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:00:00Z,2,"U-Ming is directly exposed through Capesize, Panamax, Post-Panamax and Ultramax dry-bulk vessels. CONTAINER_FREIGHT,2615,SOURCE_BACKED,2026-09-06T08:15:00Z,2,"Wan Hai identifies itself as a marine container-shipping company whose business depends on container transport demand, route deployment and freight-rate conditions; its current tariff/bunker notices show direct commercial pricing exposure on major trades.
